info.title: AquaTome owner's dashboard
info.description:
The owner's dashboard (/_ab/ on the site) as JSON, for the iOS app to draw natively (apps/site/worker/owner-api.ts). The server drives it: the dashboard lists its sections, each section is a title and a list of blocks, and each button says the request it makes, so a new section, block or button needs no app release.

Only the owner: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, the token a sign-in with client "app" returns (protocols/accounts.openapi.json), of an account the server's OWNER_ACCOUNTS names. Without a live app session, every path answers 401 `signed_out`, as the accounts API does: no Authorization, a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token sent as a bearer, the build's dashboard token, or a cookie (the web pages at /_ab/ stay cookie-only; a cookie never opens these paths). Sign in again. Another account's app session gets 404 `not_found`, as for a path that doesn't exist. Both come before any other check, so a path, a method or a key tells nobody else anything. Every reply is `cache-control: no-store` and `x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow`.

Text comes written as the web pages write it: English, numbers formatted (1,234, 12.5%, $0.11), days and times in the viewer's zone (the `Time-Zone` header), as "Thu 5 Nov, 9:00". The site's own words quoted in it (a page's title, a source's name) stay as the site writes them. A chart's numbers stay raw (see Chart). Show text as it comes; don't parse it.

Reading: the app skips a block whose `kind` it doesn't know (the section's web page, /_ab/{key}/, has everything), and ignores fields it doesn't know. A block, a section or a field may be added at any time; one is removed or changed only with a new version of this contract.

Links: a cell's `href` and a photo's `src` that start with a single "/" are on https://aquatome.com: a cell's opens the site's page; a photo's is a private image the app fetches with the same bearer. Send the bearer only for a `src` that starts with a single "/", to aquatome.com, never for one that starts with "//". A `src` that is a whole address is public: fetch it without the bearer.

Buttons (Action): send `method` to `path` with the bearer and, when there is a `body`, that body as JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`). On 200, read the section again. On an error, show its `message` when it has one. A form block is the same with fields: its fields' values (by `name`) and its `body` go as one JSON object. A switch block reads the section again from its `href`. An actions block is buttons on their own.

Errors are `{error, message?}`: `message`, when there is one, is English, to show the owner as it comes. Any path may answer 503 `unavailable` when the server can't read or write its storage just then (D1, KV, R2): try again later.

Samples: protocols/owner-dashboard-vectors.json has a reply of each path, from the Worker's own code, for the app's fake server.

Version 2 (2026-11-07, docs/design/dashboard.md): the overview's new parts (`asOf`, `tiles`, `needs`, `answers`, `shipped`, `costs`, `pages`), with `todos`, `areas` and `areasNote` kept for the app before it but deprecated; the `wait` tone, apart from `bad`; a chart's `labels` and `readouts`; folded tables sent without their rows, and long ones 50 rows at a time (GET /api/owner/sections/{key}/tables/{id}); a section's `periods`; the Comments section (`binh-luan`) and its actions; Scoreboard (`thanh-cong`) and Changelog (`thay-doi`) as sections. A series is never `bad` (a chart's series are never orange or red). Error messages are English. Then, in the same version: every section in English (2026-11-08); the overview's `lastAction`; Fish ID's periods led by "This week" (`week`, Monday to now), with today, 7 days, 30 days and the month, each figure against the same point of the period before; a folded table's `figure`; a need's `text` one short line, its detail in `sub`. Then (2026-11-09): a held-comments or waiting-photos need's `sub` names the pages they're on; `lastAction.text` is a sentence; the answers chart draws found an answer only (readers and shop clicks are in its `readouts`); the answers tile's change reads "vs last week"; Every page's Readers and Affiliate say this week so far against the same point last week, as the answers card does ("21 · −12%"), and the last 7 days only when the readers' beacon can't be read; Fish ID's keys are followed by a folded table, "Since 7:00, in detail", in place of their note.

get.summary: The overview: what needs the owner, each area's figure, and the sections

parameters.name: Time-Zone
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, as the phone has it (TimeZone.current.identifier): the reply's days and times are in it. Absent, or one the server doesn't know: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The reply says which it used (`tz`).

200.description: The overview, as the /_ab/ page shows it.

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

get.summary: One section of the dashboard, as blocks

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A section's key, as the dashboard's `sections` lists them: the /_ab/ page's path name (/_ab/noi-dung/ → noi-dung). Today's keys are listed here; take them from the dashboard rather than from this list.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: ung-dung only: "1" counts only our own test builds (debug, TestFlight), as the web page's link does; without it, only readers' builds. The section's switch block gives the address with it flipped.

parameters.name: Time-Zone
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, as the phone has it (TimeZone.current.identifier): the reply's days and times are in it. Absent, or one the server doesn't know: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The reply says which it used (`tz`).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: One of the section's `periods` keys. Absent: its first. A section with no periods, or a key it doesn't offer: 400 bad_request.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: binh-luan only: the comments filter, as each filter's `href` gives it. Absent: held.

400.description: Error: bad_request (a period the section doesn't offer; binh-luan: a state that isn't one)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path; or a key that isn't a section)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

post.summary: A reader's photo: approve one waiting (the next moderation pass publishes it, without its checks) or remove one now (waiting or shown)

200.description: Done. `changed`: false when there was nothing to do (approve: the photo no longer waits; remove: it was already removed, or never was).

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, or no `action` of the two)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (readers' photos aren't set up on this server, or the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

post.summary: Hide a page from the site (410, then out of lists, the sitemap and search), or bring it back

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, or the fields aren't these) | not_a_page (`path` isn't one page of the site, or is a home page; `message` says so)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

delete.summary: Delete a photo a reader let the fish identifier keep

parameters.name: who
parameters.description: The account that sent it, or `anon` (sent signed out), as the photo's Delete button says.

200.description: Done. `changed`: false when there was no such photo.

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (no photo storage on this server, or the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

get.summary: A waiting reader photo's upload (a photos block's `src`), while it waits
get.description: The same address the web page shows; it takes the owner's app bearer too. Private: never stored (`cache-control: private, no-store`), never indexed (`x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow`).

200.description: The image as sent (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

404.description: Not the owner (signed out too: these stay 404, never 401), or the photo no longer waits (text, not JSON).

get.summary: A kept fish-ID photo (a photos block's `src`)
get.description: The same address the web page shows; it takes the owner's app bearer too. Private: never stored, never indexed (`x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow`).

404.description: Not the owner (signed out too: these stay 404, never 401), or no such photo (text, not JSON).

get.summary: The daily report's delivery as it is now, for the app's bell: email and the phones' notifications, each on or off, as the POST answers them. Unset, email is on and notifications off.

405.description: Error: method (not GET or POST; `allow: GET, POST`)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

post.summary: The daily report's delivery: email, the phones' notifications, or both, on or off (the `bao-cao` section's buttons send it). Unset, email is on and notifications off. The notifications switch is the server's: off, no phone is notified, registered or not.

200.description: The settings as they are now; `changed`: false when they already were so.

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, no switch, a switch that isn't true or false, or another field; `message`: "email and/or push (true or false).")

405.description: Error: method (not GET or POST; `allow: GET, POST`)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

post.summary: This phone gets the daily report's notification: the app's own row ("Nhận thông báo báo cáo trên máy này") sends it at each launch while on, when turned on, and after each sign-in (the new session has none). An upsert: the same token again moves its last-seen time. The server keeps the 10 phones seen last, each tied to the app session that posted it last (it stores the session's id, never the bearer), and before each report drops every token whose session is no longer live, and any APNs answers 410 or 400 BadDeviceToken for. What the phone then gets: the Notification schema.

200.description: Kept. `changed`: the token is new here, its environment changed, or it moved to this session (false when only its time moved).

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, a token that isn't lowercase hex of 16 to 100 bytes, an environment that isn't one of the two, or another field; `message`: what it takes)

405.description: Error: method (not POST or DELETE; `allow: POST, DELETE`)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

delete.summary: This phone gets no more notifications: sent when the row is turned off, and before the owner signs out.

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, a token that isn't lowercase hex of 16 to 100 bytes, or another field: it takes `token` alone)

405.description: Error: method (not POST or DELETE; `allow: POST, DELETE`)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

get.summary: A folded or long table's rows, 50 at a time

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A `next` from the table or the page before. Absent: the first 50 rows.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The section's period, as it was read.

parameters.name: Time-Zone
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, as the phone has it (TimeZone.current.identifier): the reply's days and times are in it. Absent, or one the server doesn't know: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The reply says which it used (`tz`).

400.description: Error: bad_request (a cursor or a period that isn't one)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such section or table)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

get.summary: More comments in one state, 50 at a time

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The comments block's `next`, or the page before's.

parameters.name: Time-Zone
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, as the phone has it (TimeZone.current.identifier): the reply's days and times are in it. Absent, or one the server doesn't know: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The reply says which it used (`tz`).

400.description: Error: bad_request (no state of the three, or a cursor that isn't one)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

post.summary: A reader's comment: show it (held, or hidden within 30 days) or hide it. The owner's decision sets its reason ("Shown by the owner", "Hidden by the owner"), so the nightly moderation doesn't take it up again unless a reader reports it later.

200.description: Done. `changed`: false when it was already in that state.

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, or no `action` of the two)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such comment, or one deleted 30 days after it was hidden)

409.description: Error: expired (show: hidden more than 30 days ago, waiting to be deleted)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

bearer.description: The app: the token from a sign-in with client "app" (protocols/accounts.openapi.json), of the owner's account.

Tz.description: The IANA time zone the reply's days and times are in.

todos.description: What needs the owner now, most pressing first; empty when nothing does (the web page says "Nothing needs you right now."). Deprecated: the overview before version 2; read `needs` and `pages`.

areas.description: One row an area, in the page's order. Deprecated: the overview before version 2; read `needs` and `pages`.

areasNote.description: The note under the areas: what the figures and chips compare. Deprecated: the overview before version 2; read `needs` and `pages`.

log.description: The last three days: what happened each day.

sections.description: Every section, in the web dashboard's order and with its names: the app's list of what it can open.

asOf.description: When the figures were read: "figures as of 9:41".

tiles.description: Needs you, Found an answer, Shipped in 24 hours, the cost: in that order.

needs.description: What needs the owner now, most pressing first.

needsEmpty.description: The line when `needs` is empty: "Nothing needs you right now".

pages.description: Every page but the overview, grouped, each with its figure: the web's rail, and the overview's "Every page".

text.description: What the owner did, in words, the page by its name and its language when it isn't Vietnamese: "You hid a comment on Ikan neon (Indonesian)", "You approved a reader photo on Cá betta (cá xiêm)", "You hid the page Cá betta (cá xiêm)" (a page this build doesn't have, by its address: "You hid the page at /ca/x/").

when.description: When, in the viewer's zone: "Wed 4 Nov, 8:00".

at.description: The same moment, for the app's own use.

section.description: The section it happened in, to open.

lastAction.description: The owner's newest decision on record (a comment shown or hidden, a reader photo approved or removed, a page hidden), for under the all clear when `needs` is empty; the web page shows it there too. null: none on record, or the records couldn't be read.

publishing.description: New pages by kind and day: the overview's "New pages" card. Absent while the build's figures or the nightly saves can't be read, or none is saved yet; an app without it draws the overview as before.

TodoAction.description: Where to deal with it: a section (by key), or an address elsewhere (a GitHub run) to open in the browser.

anchor.description: Where in the section: the `anchor` of one of its headings. Open the section scrolled to it.

section.description: The section it opens (and `anchor`, where in it).

fig.description: Its figure, written ("1.234", "—" when it couldn't load).

sub.description: What the figure counts, or why it couldn't load.

spark.description: The 30 whole days before today, oldest first, as small columns: the last 7 are the figure's days, the 7 before them the chip's comparison. null: a day not recorded (draw nothing). Empty: no columns for this area.

anchor.description: Where in the section: the `anchor` of one of its headings. Open the section scrolled to it.

text.description: "+18%", or the difference itself while counts are small ("+4").

vs.description: What it compares with, for VoiceOver: "vs {vs}".

Log.description: The last three days, newest first.

entries.description: Each day's entries, newest day first. A day with nothing new is one entry, tone muted. Group them by `at`. Deprecated: the overview before version 2; read `days`.

days.description: One row a day, newest first.

text.description: The day's other lines in one: "11 fish ID calls ($0.11) · 1 new comment · 1 page hidden"; "Nothing else" on a quiet day.

section.description: The section the row opens, when there is one.

at.description: The day, written in the viewer's zone ("Today · 4 Nov · so far", "Yesterday · 3 Nov", "Mon 2 Nov"); the same for every entry of that day.

section.description: The section it opens, when there is one.

url.description: Or an address elsewhere, to open in the browser.

periods.description: What the period menu offers, in its order. Absent: the section has one period, as its text says.

period.description: The period every figure of the section is for: one of `periods`. Present with `periods`.

Block.description: One part of a section, by `kind`. A part that couldn't load is a note (tone bad) in its place; the rest of the section still comes.

level.description: 2: a part of the section; 3: a part within it.

anchor.description: The name a to-do, an area or a log entry gives as `anchor` to open the section here (the web page's #id).

meter.description: A share of a whole, drawn as a thin bar under the figure (the text says the figure).

text.description: "+12% vs last week", "−3 pts vs the 7 days before".

Delta.description: A change against an earlier period. The server colours it: good or bad only past 5% and only where more is plainly better (or worse), muted otherwise; show the tone as it comes.

Chart.description: Columns over days, as the web page's charts (apps/site/worker/admin/chart.ts DayChart): stacked from the baseline in the series' order, a negative value below it; `whole` a pale column behind them. Values are raw numbers, for drawing and the axis; every word a reader sees about a bar is in `labels` and `readouts`. Write axis numbers as the section's text writes its numbers, money with `unit`.

days.description: Oldest first, in the viewer's zone (or the days the data is kept by, Vietnam's or a nightly save's: the section's notes say so). A chart starts where its count does, so it can have fewer days than its window.

unit.description: usd: dollars ("$0.11", "$0.0042" below a cent). Absent: counts.

partialLast.description: The last day is still being counted: drawn lighter. It is today, or, on a chart kept by a nightly save, the day the next save closes, which can be yesterday by the viewer's clock: don't call it today yourself, `labels` and `readouts` say it.

empty.description: What to say when every value is 0 or missing.

missing.description: Why a null day has no value.

labels.description: One per day, its axis label as the web page writes it ("Thu", "Today"; a week, its Monday: "2 Nov").

readouts.description: One per day, oldest first: what a tap on its bar shows.

today.description: Today's bar, drawn lighter (the day isn't over), when the chart runs past it (a week, Monday to Sunday): the days after it are still to come (null). A chart whose last day is still being counted says so with `partialLast` and this too.

period.description: week: each of `days` is a week's Monday (the scoreboard's weeks), and each bar a week.

values.description: One per day; null: the day wasn't recorded.

tone.description: Absent: s1, s2, s3 by position (the chart's own colours, never orange or red). mute: context only.

rows.description: Each row has a cell per column; the first names the row.

empty.description: What to show when there are no rows.

folded.description: Drawn closed, opened by this label (the web page's disclosure). Its rows aren't sent (`rows` is empty, `count` says how many): opening it reads GET /api/owner/sections/{key}/tables/{id}.

id.description: Unique in the section; present when the table is folded or has more rows than it sends.

count.description: How many rows it has in all, when that is more than `rows` holds (folded, or more to come).

next.description: More rows to come: GET /api/owner/sections/{key}/tables/{id}?cursor={next} gives the next 50.

figure.description: A folded table's figure, on the right of its label: "$0.77", "95".

Table.description: A table. One with more than 50 rows comes with its first 50 and `next`.

href.description: A page of the site, from "/" (open it as the app opens the site's pages).

src.description: From "/": private, fetch it with the bearer. A whole address: public.

Hidden.description: Pages taken down, newest first. Hide another with POST /api/owner/hidden.

note.description: Why, as the owner wrote it.

Form.description: A form: on submit, send `method` to `path` as an Action does, with the fields' values (each under its `name`; an empty optional field left out) and `body` as one JSON object.

body.description: Sent with the fields, as it is.

label.description: What the field asks, for the label or VoiceOver.

Switch.description: A switch between two forms of the section: show it `on` or off; flipping it reads the section from `href` and shows that instead.

href.description: The section with the switch flipped: GET it with the bearer.

Actions.description: Buttons on their own, in a row (a setting's on and off): each makes its request as an Action does, then the section is read again.

Action.description: A button: the request it makes.

body.description: Sent as JSON, as it is.

path.description: The page: a path or a whole address on the site, in any language ("/ca/x/", "https://aquatome.com/id/ikan/x/").

hide.description: true: hide it; false: bring it back.

path.description: The page as the list keeps it.

token.description: The APNs device token as lowercase hex (64 digits today).

environment.description: `sandbox` from debug builds, `production` from TestFlight and App Store builds: the APNs host the server sends to.

token.description: The APNs device token as lowercase hex (64 digits today).

message.description: English, to show the owner as it comes.

Notification.description: The daily report's notification, as APNs gets it from the Worker for each phone registered (/api/owner/push-token) in a live session of the owner's, when a report is made (07:00 Vietnam time, or a run started by hand) and the push switch is on. Sent with apns-topic com.aquatome.app, apns-push-type alert and apns-collapse-id daily-report-<the report's id>, so a report pushed twice doesn't stack. No sound or badge.

body.description: The report's subject, then on a line of its own the first thing that needs care, if there is one; English, as the report is. Cut to 400 characters, ending in an ellipsis.

url.description: The report's page on the dashboard. The app opens it on a tap, and ignores a url that isn't https on aquatome.com; a browser is sent on to the dashboard's own address, where Cloudflare Access asks a signed-out owner to sign in, and lands on the report.

Tone.description: plain: ordinary text; muted: secondary, or an empty state; good: done, or better by more than 5%; wait: waits on the owner (orange in the app, rust on the web); bad: a fault, worse by more than 5%, or (a button) deletes (red).

Readout.description: What a tap on a bar (or a drag across) shows over it, written: the web page shows the same words.

title.description: The bar's main figure and what it counts: "21 found an answer".

detail.description: Its day and the other figures that day: "Thu 5 Nov · 29 readers · 1 shop click".

Bars.description: A tile's small bars, one per day, each with what a tap on it shows.

days.description: Oldest first, in the viewer's zone.

values.description: One per day; null: nothing to draw (a day still to come, or not recorded).

today.description: Today's bar, drawn lighter; the days after it are still to come (null). Absent: today isn't among them.

rows.description: Up to 50 rows, each a cell per column of the table's `columns`.

next.description: More to come: ask again with `cursor` set to it. Absent: the last page.

key.description: Fish ID's: week (this week, Monday to now: the first and default), today, d7 (7 days), d30 (30 days), month (this month). Others may come; send back the key as it comes.

label.description: "This week", "Today", "7 days", "30 days", "November" (the month by its name).

CommentState.description: held: waits, unseen by readers; shown: on its page; hidden: removed from its page, deleted 30 days after.

path.description: The site page it was posted on (open it as the app opens the site's pages). Absent when the site no longer has the page: `title` then reads "a page no longer on the site".

at.description: When it was posted (UTC; write it in the viewer's zone).

reason.description: Why it is in this state, in plain English: "Held when posted: it has “zalo:”, a blocked term", "Held after a report", "Hidden by the owner". Empty when there is nothing to say (shown when posted).

reports.description: Every report signed-in readers made on it, oldest first, each reason as they wrote it ("" for none given). It keeps the reports from before a decision too. Absent when it has none.

actions.description: Held: Show and Hide. Shown: Hide. Hidden: Show again, until 30 days after it was hidden.

href.description: The section with this filter: read it and show it in place.

Comments.description: Readers' comments in one state, newest first, 50 at a time, under a filter by state.

filters.description: Held, Shown, Hidden, each with its count; the one equal to `state` is chosen.

empty.description: What to show when there are none in this state.

next.description: More to come: ask again with `cursor` set to it. Absent: the last page.

action.description: show: on its page (a held one, or a hidden one within its 30 days); hide: off its page, deleted 30 days later.

Tile.description: One of the overview's four tiles, each leading to its part below.

key.description: Which part it leads to: needs, answers, shipped, costs.

label.description: "Needs you", "Found an answer", "Shipped in 24 hours", "Fish ID cost, this week".

sub.description: "4 to review · 2 to fix", "95 Claude calls".

delta.description: Its change, one line: the answers tile's "+8% vs last week".

bars.description: The answers tile's small columns: the week's seven days, today's drawn lighter and the days to come empty (null).

Need.description: One thing that needs the owner: the line, and where to deal with it (a section, or an address elsewhere).

kind.description: For its icon. comments: held comments; photos: readers' photos waiting; key: the fish ID keys; spend: a day's AI spend (fish ID and chat) past 80% of its daily cap; engine: the content engine; moderation: the nightly moderation missed a night; failed: a part of the dashboard that couldn't load.

text.description: The thing, on one line at regular size (at most 36 characters): "5 comments held for review", "Fish ID and chat are down". Its detail is in `sub`.

sub.description: The detail, smaller, under it: "Every key resting, the first until Wed 4 Nov, 16:30.". Held comments and waiting photos: the pages they're on, the first three and how many more ("Cá neon vua · Cá betta (cá xiêm)"). Dates in it are "Wed 4 Nov, 16:30", in the viewer's zone.

label.description: The web page's button: "Review", "See key", "See engine".

tone.description: wait: to review; bad: to fix.

section.description: The section it opens (and `anchor`, where in it).

url.description: Or an address elsewhere, to open in the browser.

photos.description: Readers' photos waiting, by id, for thumbnails: GET /_ab/anh/{id} with the bearer.

Answers.description: Readers who found an answer (the scoreboard's star): from search, then stayed 30 s or read half the page, so never more than readers. A week runs Monday to Sunday in Vietnam's time; days still to come are null.

figure.description: This week so far, against the same point last week.

chart.description: This week by day, Monday to Sunday: found an answer only. Each day's readers and shop clicks are in its `readouts` ("Tue 3 Nov · 8 readers · 1 shop click"), not drawn.

figures.description: Readers, sessions and shop clicks this week so far, each against the same point last week.

Shipped.description: The changelog's lines of the last 24 hours, newest first (the daily report adds them each morning).

empty.description: What to show when nothing shipped.

section.description: The whole changelog: its row reads "Changelog · 3 in 24 h".

lines.description: What the server counts: fish ID this week and over 30 days.

keys.description: The fish ID keys' state, a row that opens their page.

fixed.description: Costs not counted, as lines: "Engine: Claude subscription, flat", "Cloudflare: fixed plan".

note.description: "Only fish ID is counted so far", until more is.

figure.description: What waits on the owner there if anything ("2 held", tone wait), a fault (tone bad), else its main figure ("169 · +2%", tone plain).

Stall.description: Pages that stopped coming: since when, and the line that says it.

since.description: The last time the count was seen higher than the time before: a night's save (20:17 UTC) or a build.

text.description: "No new species pages since Fri 13 Nov, 3:17", "Nothing new since Thu 12 Nov, 3:17".

PublishingKind.description: One kind's pages: its total now, and what each night added.

key.description: fish: species pages (fish, shrimp, snails); guide: written guides; videoGuide: guides written from a video; plant: plant pages.

total.description: Its pages now in Vietnamese, written as a tile's value: "2,503".

bars.description: One bar a day, oldest first: what that night's save added less the save before it (a loss draws none; its readout says "2 fewer"), null for a night not saved. `today` is the last, so far: this build's count less the last save.

stalled.description: Only when it has added nothing for 24 hours while it has work waiting (a page source of its kind with pages waiting; for video guides, the video queue), and the other kinds haven't all stopped too. The same line is in `needs` as kind `engine`.

Publishing.description: New pages by kind and day (apps/site/worker/admin/publishing.ts).

kinds.description: Species pages, guides, video guides, plant pages: always these four, in this order.

missing.description: Why a bar is missing, when one is: "No count was kept that night."

quiet.description: Every kind has added nothing for 24 hours: the engine's, one line (also in `needs`, kind `engine`), and no kind has its own `stalled`.
